note: Source register created in this repository. Earlier references (S01-S24, FLG-003, SG-27-SG-30) were not present in the repo and were not reconstructed. Status values: Verified = text read on the official page; Partly verified = official page read in part, or claim taken from an official search excerpt, full-page check pending; Not reviewed = linked but not read.

sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.supports: Section 5 disclosure text: 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' Must be clearly and prominently stated on the site. Section 5 also bars misrepresenting the Amazon relationship.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies (incl. Participation Requirements and Commission Income Statement)
sources.supports: Participation Requirements 2(b): Special Links must carry the Associates tag as a URL parameter (format XXXXX-##, or another format Amazon designates). 2(v): no cloaking or obscuring of the site URL, including by redirecting links. 2(w): no link shortening service or placement that makes it unclear that the link goes to an Amazon Site. Full-page confirmation of 2(b), 2(v), 2(w) is pending manual review. Text was read from official search excerpts.

sources.title: Product Advertising API 5.0 - GetItems
sources.supports: Defines ASIN as 'Amazon Standard Identification Number: 10-Character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.' Text read from official search excerpt; page not fetched in full.

sources.title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
sources.supports: Disclose any financial relationship; place the disclosure where it is hard to miss, with the endorsement; not only on an About page or at the end of a post; use clear terms like 'ad' or 'sponsored'; do not make up claims that would need proof you don't have. Linked Endorsement Guides PDF was not reviewed (SRC-13).

sources.title: Qualify your outbound links to Google (rel="sponsored")
sources.supports: rel="sponsored" marks advertisements or paid placements, including affiliate links, with the sponsored value. Multiple rel values may be combined.

sources.title: Amazon Associates Central - Contact Us
sources.supports: Link observed in the Operating Agreement page navigation (SRC-01). Listed as the owner's route to ask Associates about the submitted links (see Q-02). Not opened.
